title: faxxen
description: Vanilla+ Modpack for private SMPs. Enhanced performance, structure generation and QOL updates.
body:
🌍 Faxxen – The Ultimate Vanilla+ SMP Experience
Welcome to the definitive collection for our private SMP. This modpack was meticulously curated to maintain the authentic "Vanilla" feel while overhauling the technical foundation and breathing new life into world exploration. No bloat, just better gameplay.

🚀 Performance & Server Optimization
We believe a smooth experience is a human right. This pack includes the most advanced optimization mods available to ensure high FPS and a lag-free server environment.

Modern Rendering: Features Distant Horizons for breathtaking draw distances without melting your GPU.

Core Efficiency: Powered by Lithium, FerriteCore, Krypton, and C2ME to optimize everything from memory usage to chunk generation.

Server Stability: ServerCore, ThreadTweak, and Very Many Players (VMP) ensure the server stays responsive even with multiple players exploring simultaneously.

Network & Fixes: Packet Fixer and Ksyxis handle connection stability and lightning-fast world loading.

🏰 Reimagined World Exploration
The world is your playground, and we’ve made it a lot more interesting to explore.

Structure Overhauls: The complete Dungeons and Taverns suite along with Moog’s Reimagined structures transform vanilla Strongholds, Ancient Cities, and Temples into massive, rewarding adventures.

Subtle Biome Enhancements: Geophilic adds depth to vanilla biomes, while Unnamed Desert and Hopo Better Underwater Ruins fill the gaps in the world.

Dynamic Challenges: Face the Illager Invasion and discover new threats lurking in the shadows of redesigned outposts.

🛠 Quality of Life & Gameplay
"Vanilla+" is about removing friction. These additions make the daily grind feel like a breeze.

Utility Tools: RightClickHarvest for easy farming, Leaves Be Gone to stop floating foliage, and Easy Anvils/Magic to fix the most annoying parts of enchanting.

Combat & Interaction: Axes Are Weapons makes your tools versatile, while ItemPhysic adds a layer of immersion to dropped items.

Inventory Management: Features Mouse Wheelie for quick sorting and Shulker Box Tooltip to see inside your storage without placing it.

Bartering & Trading: Use the Bartering Station for streamlined Piglin trading and Universal Bone Meal for more flexible gardening.

🎙️ SMP & Social Features
Built specifically for a multiplayer community.

Proximity Voice Chat: Simple Voice Chat allows for natural conversations based on your in-game position.

Customization: Express yourself with Show Me Your Skin! and vastly expanded Armor, Tool, and Elytra Trims.

Integrity & Privacy: No Chat Reports ensures private conversations stay private, and Vanish helps with administrative oversight.

Interactive World: Use /sit to chill with friends or watch items actually appear on the Visual Workbench.

🗺️ Information & UI
Always know what you’re looking at and where you’re going.

Comprehensive Mapping: Xaero’s Minimap and World Map work in tandem to keep you on track.

In-Game Guides: Jade (What Am I Looking At?), AppleSkin (Saturation/Hunger info), and JEI/REI for all your recipe needs.

Technical Feedback: spark and TT20 help monitor performance, while Almanac provides a clean interface for game data.

📋 Installation Notes
Recommended RAM: 4GB to 6GB is the sweet spot for this pack.

Note for Players: This pack is built on Fabric 1.21.1. Please ensure you are using the correct version of the Modrinth or Prism Launcher for the best experience.
